name: Herbal Dispatch Inc.
summary: Herbal Dispatch Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of cannabis and cannabis related products in Canada and internationally. The company offers dried flowers, pre-rolls, concentrates, vapes, edibles, oils and capsules, topicals, CBD, seeds, and accessories, as well as small-batch craft and curated cannabis products. It also provides packaging and processing services. The company sells its products under various brand names through cannabis e-commerce platforms. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
